configuration.showEditorTitleIcon.descri: Show the JSON(L) Preview icon in the editor title bar for JSON, JSONL, NDJSON, and untitled files.
configuration.json.indent.description: Number of spaces used by JSON formatting.
configuration.json.allowComments.descrip: Allow JavaScript-style comments while parsing JSON previews. This does not affect JSONL or NDJSON.
configuration.json.allowTrailingComma.de: Allow trailing commas while parsing JSON previews. This does not affect JSONL or NDJSON.
configuration.json.maxAutoExpandDepth.de: Maximum number of JSON tree levels expanded automatically. Deeper nodes remain available for manual expansion.
configuration.jsonl.pageSize.description: Number of JSONL or NDJSON records requested per page.
configuration.jsonl.schemaSampleSize.des: Number of initial JSONL or NDJSON records sampled to discover table columns.
configuration.jsonl.ignoreEmptyLines.des: Ignore blank and whitespace-only physical lines. When disabled, each empty line is shown as an error row.
configuration.largeFileThresholdMB.descr: Use the read-only streaming preview above this size for clean local JSONL and NDJSON files. JSON files always use normal mode.
configuration.normalModeMaxFileMB.descri: Maximum file size loaded completely in normal mode. Also limits conversion and some non-file exports.
configuration.maxLineLengthMB.descriptio: Maximum JSONL or NDJSON line size parsed completely. Longer lines are shown as errors with a truncated preview.
configuration.maxSortableRows.descriptio: Maximum number of indexed physical lines allowed for field sorting. Original-order sorting remains available.
configuration.queryCacheMB.description: Memory budget for the JSONL line index, query results, and sorting data. Larger files or broad filters may require a higher value.
configuration.timezone.description: Time zone used to display recognized timestamps. Use "system" or an IANA name such as "Asia/Shanghai".
